title: A Benchmark for Understanding Dialogue Safety in Mental Health Support
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark measures dialogue safety in mental health support contexts, focusing on categories like nonsense, linguistic neglect, toxic language, and unauthorized preachment (defined as inappropriate advice or persuasion, not religious preaching).
findings: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion or faith; its focus is on dialogue safety in mental health support.
